flows.name: Full shopping cart to demo COD
flows.steps: Home > collection > size and color filter > product sku-01 > choose M ivory > add qty 2 > cart > set shipping zone > apply valid promo > checkout > server recalculates > create simulated order > order summary route > admin sees DEMO order.
flows.oracle: Totals match server and data, stock cannot go negative, receipts session-protected.

flows.name: Out-of-stock handling
flows.steps: Product > select sold-out size/color > add disabled with meaningful text > select available > add 1 > return cart.
flows.oracle: Variant selection correctly prevents unavailable combinations.

flows.name: Coupon rejection
flows.steps: Cart > enter expired or below-minimum coupon > error inline > valid coupon passes > total updated.

design: Modern fashion editorial with warm white, desaturated rose and ink; campaign art direction, bold typography and material details. Avoid default template/store builder demo appearance. Product imagery consistent by SKU/color.
signatureFeatures: Real SKU and variant inventory availability (at least 3 sizes and 3 colors across items)
Persistent cart with line merge only for same variant, quantity and stock constraints
Pricing engine: subtotal + deterministic sample shipping – valid discount = total
Working product search/filter/sort, wish list and recently viewed
Simulated checkout and order status read-only viewer with no delivery guarantee
seedRequirements: 24 products, 4 collections, minimum 60 variants, 5 size charts/material guides, 4 editorial journal articles, 3 demo promo rules incl expired/min-cart, 3 shipping zones/prices, 5 intentionally sold-out variants.
adminRequirements: Product catalog, variants, stock, collections, editorial sections, sample promo rules and shipping zones, demo orders (SIMULATED) with read-only timeline. Changes to stock must appear in product, search, cart and checkout validation.
negativeScenarios: sku-01 M ivory stock=7; qty 2 works and decrements simulated availability only if order policy says so
Sold-out combination stock=0; add action disabled
Promo 10% requires >=1000 EGP, max 200 EGP; expired code rejected
Cairo shipping 70 EGP, Alexandria 95 EGP, other zone 125 EGP (all illustrative)
Two distinct variants stay separate in cart; same variant merges
Session A cannot see Session B demo order
